TITLE:
Indoor Poolside Portrait

IDENTITY LOCK:
None.

STYLE:
Ultra-realistic photorealism.
Authentic handheld iPhone 16 Pro photography.
Casual Instagram-style lifestyle photo.
Natural HDR with minimal retouching.
Authentic skin texture.

SUBJECT:
Beautiful Japanese woman in her early 20s.
Long dark brown hair with soft see-through bangs, slightly damp from swimming.
Large dark brown eyes.
Natural makeup.
Healthy fair skin.

BODY:
Pronounced feminine hourglass figure.
Naturally full bust.
Natural feminine curves.
Realistic anatomy.

OUTFIT:
Shiny metallic deep blue triangle bikini.
Thin halter-neck strings.
Matching side-tie string bikini bottoms.
Barefoot.

SCENE / ENVIRONMENT:
Modern upscale indoor swimming pool.
Sitting on the stone poolside beside clear blue water.
Large floor-to-ceiling windows.
Contemporary pale stone interior with subtle reflections from the pool.
Quiet, relaxed atmosphere.

POSE / EXPRESSION:
Sitting low on the poolside with both knees deeply bent and opened outward.
Legs relaxed in a natural asymmetric squat-like seated position.
Right hand placed behind her on the poolside for support.
Left arm relaxed naturally.
Body slightly tilted to the right.
Upper body leaning slightly toward the camera.
Looking directly into the camera with a soft charming smile.

CAMERA:
Vertical 3:4 composition.
Eye-level to slightly low perspective.
Close natural smartphone distance.
Full seated pose visible.
Natural handheld framing.

LIGHTING:
Soft daylight entering through the large windows.
Natural indoor ambient light.
Subtle blue reflections from the pool.
Soft realistic shadows.

DETAILS:
Slightly damp hair.
Small realistic water droplets on the skin.
Natural skin texture.
Realistic reflections on the water and metallic bikini fabric.

NEGATIVE / CONSTRAINTS:
No CGI.
No illustration.
No anime.
No plastic skin.
No text or watermark.
No malformed anatomy or extra limbs.
